description: Seagulls have a notorious reputation for swiping meals, snacks and basically anything remotely edible that they can get their beaks on. Now, some restaurants in Sydney, Australia, have come up with a solution: they've trained canines to chase away gulls. The seagull patrol consists of some 35 dogs – especially from herding breeds. Training involves adapting the dogs' natural herding instincts to chase off the pesky avian scavengers.
title: It's Dogs Versus Seagulls
